title: UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain

comments.text: Says the `<<` string concatenation in the discourse_host.ends_with? check mutates the original string and could alter Discourse.current_hostname. Suggests using `+` instead. Suggested change: replace `<<` with `+` in the ends_with? check.
Notes that URI(website.to_s) is parsed twice in website_name, and suggests storing the parsed URI in a variable for efficiency.
